description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Deranged Hermit that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Deranged Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
